name: Alistair Davies
bio:
Alistair Davies's motorsport journey began not on the track, but in the garage. Growing up in a family of mechanics, Alistair quickly developed a fascination with the inner workings of racing cars. He honed his skills through various engineering roles before transitioning to team management. His analytical mind and dedication to precision proved invaluable. 

As Team Principal, Alistair emphasizes data-driven decision-making and a collaborative team environment. He believes that success comes from empowering each team member to contribute their best. However, Alistair's relentless pursuit of perfection can sometimes put pressure on his staff, as he always strives to push the team to achieve even greater heights. His focus on long-term strategy and his open communication style are vital to FVee Brasil's success.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly parted with a slight wave
physical.description: Alistair has a focused gaze and a lean build.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen for jotting down ideas.
Has a habit of tapping his fingers on the desk when deep in thought.
Insists on arriving at the track two hours before anyone else.
